def merge_subarrays(array, left, mid, right):
    n_left = mid - left + 1
    n_right = right - mid
    leftPart = array[left:mid+1]
    rightPart = array[mid+1:right+1]
    i, j, k = 0, 0, left
    while i < n_left and j < n_right:
        if leftPart[i] <= rightPart[j]:
            array[k] = leftPart[i]
            i += 1
        else:
            array[k] = rightPart[j]
            j += 1
        k += 1
    while i < n_left:
        array[k] = leftPart[i]
        i += 1
        k += 1
    while j < n_right:
        array[k] = rightPart[j]
        j += 1
        k += 1

def sortArray(array, start, end):
    if start < end:
        mid = start + (end - start) // 2
        sortArray(array, start, mid)
        sortArray(array, mid + 1, end)
        merge_subarrays(array, start, mid, end)
